campaigns.title: The journey is only proven while the runner actually drains the collector

mutants.breaks: the collector accumulates records in memory and the run ends without persisting them, so `sw usage` shows nothing for a run that really did spend tokens

campaigns.title: The collector must be installed by the factory, not assumed by the test

mutants.breaks: the adapter reaching RunContext.model.llm is never a TelemetryCollector, so flush_telemetry returns at its isinstance guard and nothing is ever recorded — the exact silent-no-op shape this contract exists to catch
